# Anthony Tulk

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c7 P5](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0005)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 c5 P3](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0003)</sub>

## Appearance

Anthony has a small, dark, gloomy face and black eyes filled with enmity. He possesses a sullen exterior and is known to walk with an impertinent swagger.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c7 P5](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0005), [v2 c12 P1](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0001)_

## Personality

Anthony is cheeky, self-reliant, and forms his own opinions. He holds a haughty disdain for female teachers, initially viewing them as useless. Despite his insolent and sullen attitude, he respects strength and direct discipline over gentle treatment.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010), [v2 c7 P5](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0005), [v2 c7 P7](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0007), [v2 c12 P50](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0050), [v2 c12 P52](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0052)_

- Dark and gloomy expression  <sub>[v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004)</sub>

## Abilities

- Clever student  <sub>[v2 c7 P5](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0005)</sub>

## History

Anthony Tulk, an orphaned nephew taken in by Mrs. Laurence Tulk, began attending Brierley school under the instruction of Nell Harcourt. From his arrival, he held a sullen disdain for Nell due to his belief that female teachers were useless. On his first day, he emptied his slate bottle down a girl's neck, and later placed a live mouse in Nell's desk drawer. After admitting to the prank with insolence, Nell lost her temper and gave him a whipping with a wooden pointer. Contrary to Nell's fears that she had lost him forever, the whipping earned Anthony's respect, causing him to offer to carry her books the next morning and remark that she had some worth after all. When Nell eventually resigned as teacher, Anthony engaged in two deliberate fights with other boys to process his emotions.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c5 P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010), [v2 c7 P7](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0007), [v2 c12 P23](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0023), [v2 c12 P30](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0030), [v2 c12 P33](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0033), [v2 c12 P49](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0049), [v2 c12 P52](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0052), [v2 c26 P34](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0034)_
